title: Unnatural Death
description: A mystery surrounding the sudden and unexpected death of Miss Mullen Paley, an elderly woman suffering from cancer, and the subsequent events that reveal a sinister plot involving inheritance, murder, and deception.
intro_narrative: In the quiet town of Leahampton, Hampshire, the sudden death of Miss Mullen Paley, despite medical expectations of a longer life, raises suspicions. Her niece, Miss James Gaye, inherits her fortune, but the circumstances surrounding the death and the dismissal of the maids, Olsen and Bell Chappelle, hint at something more nefarious. Detective-Sandler Jagger and Lord Rudd Green delve into the mystery, uncovering clues that point to foul play and a web of deceit spun by those closest to the victim.

required_motive: Inheritance under the new Property Act
